# Elevate Stats

> Elevate Stats is a hockey stats tracking app for amateur coaches. Capture,
> share, and learn from every game, right from the bench, even when the rink
> has no signal. Elevate Stats is made by Elevate Sports Labs Inc., a Canadian
> company.

Pricing: the Free tier includes unlimited team-level game tracking, forever.
PRO is $14 CAD per month or $109 CAD per year and adds player and goalie
stats, plus-minus and faceoffs, AI insights powered by ElevateIQ, opponent
analysis and shot maps, full season analytics, CSV import and export, and full
game history. Your first 3 games unlock PRO tracking and stats, with no credit
card required. Custom
plans are available for clubs, associations, and leagues.

- Plus-minus (PRO): tap who was on the ice for every goal that counts.
- Faceoffs (PRO): tap a dot, mark it Won or Lost, and pick who took it. See win rates by zone, for the team and each player.
- Power play and penalty kill: flip the PP switch to get PP%, PK% and power play goals.
- Stats keepers: invite a parent or team manager to track games for your team.
- Every Elevate Coach subscription includes Stats PRO.

The app runs at https://app.elevatestats.app (a progressive web app, no
app store install required).
